sources.core_vocabulary: PiPhi Network Core and maintained PiPhi integrations
sources.parent_contract: PiPhi Modbus integration serial transport contract

groups.reason: The scaffold implements configuration presence, connectivity state, refresh dispatch, and sanitized configuration events.

The authenticated parent supplies a stable /dev/serial/by-id path and bounded baud/data/parity/stop/timeout settings. The sidecar rejects paths outside that mount and duplicate ownership of one resolved physical bus, owns exclusive session access, closes cleanly, reconnects after transport failure, redacts the path, and reports port and unit responsiveness separately. Generic USB discovery, adapter metadata, flow control and custom RS-485 direction timing remain demand-driven platform/device features.

RTU validates bounded binary frames, CRC, unit, function and exceptions and enforces the required 3.5-character inter-frame silence (1.75 ms above 19,200 baud). ASCII validates colon/CRLF delimiters, bounded even-length hexadecimal payloads, LRC, unit, function and exceptions. Both use configured bounded response timeouts and one in-flight transaction.

A bounded serialized queue permits one profile-resolved request at a time. Units are 1-247, profile points fix areas and addresses, protocol responses are correlated by unit/function, writes are not retried, and broadcasts/raw frames are impossible through the API.

The bounded queue rejects saturation, tracks depth/capacity/high-water, permits one in-flight transaction, exposes secret-free timeout/framing/transport/reconnect and per-unit health, and is reconfigured by the parent after restart. Writes are never retried, so persistent write idempotency and manual circuit/queue mutation controls are neither required nor exposed.
Arbitrary serial access, raw frames, unrestricted addresses/functions, broadcasts, destructive diagnostics, device semantics, and credentials remain outside the transport sidecar.
